risks.risk: Exact camera model is not readable; pricing depends heavily on model (e.g., D3300/D3200/700D/60D/M50 etc.).
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of the camera front/top showing the model name (e.g., 'Canon 700D' / 'Nikon D3300') and a photo of the lens mount label.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used APS-C DSLR body (worst-case within the comparable range) rather than a specific higher-value model.

risks.risk: Shutter count claim may be false; high shutter count can reduce value.
risks.proof: Ask for a screenshot/photo of shutter count from a shutter-count app/tool or a clear camera-menu readout (and EXIF if available).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven (worst-case) rather than 'under 5,000'.

risks.risk: Lens condition (fungus/scratches) is not shown; lens damage can be costly.
risks.proof: Ask for close-up photos of the lens front element and rear element under bright light (and a photo of the lens at an angle to show haze/fungus).
risks.if_unproven: Price as if lens may have issues (worst-case) unless close-ups confirm clean glass.

risks.risk: Whether it includes lens is unclear from the single back-photo; body-only vs kit changes price.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo showing the full camera with the lens attached and another photo showing what exactly is included (battery, charger, lens).
risks.if_unproven: Price as body-only or least-included option among the matches until inclusion is confirmed.

risks.risk: Functionality (AF, buttons, shutter, video, ports) not testable from this photo.
risks.proof: Ask for a short video clip showing autofocus working and recording 1080p, plus a photo of the live view.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully proven working (worst-case) rather than fully functional.

proof_requests: Photo of the camera front/top showing the exact model name (brand + model) and a photo of the lens mount label.
Close-up clear photos of the lens front and rear glass under bright light (to confirm no fungus/scratches).
Screenshot/photo of shutter count (from a shutter-count tool or EXIF) showing the number.
Photos showing what is included: battery, charger, and whether a lens is included (and which lens model).
Short test video (autofocus + recording) and a photo of the live view screen.
response.reason: The photo does not clearly identify the exact camera model or verify key claims (shutter count, lens condition, included accessories). Without those, a safe worst-case price cannot be chosen from the comparables.
